Hi all — quick update from the SRE side after an initial telemetry pass.

What we found so far (preliminary):
- Verified an elevated 5xx rate for FastCart's tenant exactly between 01:06:12 and 01:17:49 UTC.
- Root cause appears to be a short-lived thundering‑herd of warmup traffic that led to KV cache evictions on a subset of serving pods; eviction storms amplified latency and produced cascading 503s while nodes warmed back up.
- Autoscaler did not add capacity during the window due to a concurrent short spike in pod churn from an infra restart (we have the restart event in the control plane logs at 01:03:58 UTC).

Attachments: slo-eligibility-summary.xlsx (contains availability math & preliminary prorated credit calc), and I've placed raw trace bundle at the shared drive link in the thread metadata.

Next steps:
1) We will produce a final verified impact window by 18:00 UTC today with the raw log bundles needed for your audit.
2) If the final window confirms an availability violation under the contract language (99.95% monthly), we will propose a proportional credit and schedule a joint postmortem for next week.

Questions for FastCart: please confirm whether you observed any client-side retries that would change amplification calculations (a few percentage points changes the prorate). If possible, share the sample request IDs referenced in Priya's original message.

Karthik
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
